ai_review.summary: A pristine soundboard recording captures a soaring 1969 performance highlighted by a ferocious The Other One, epic Dark Star and a legendary New Potato Caboose.
ai_review.review: The multitrack sound‑board source is crystal clear, delivering every nuance of the band’s peak 1969 energy. Reviewers rave about nonstop flow, blistering renditions of The Other One, Dark Star, New Potato Caboose and a surprise Hey Jude encore, with Jerry’s SG tone described as ferocious and Phil’s bass on fire. Overall it’s hailed as one of the dead‑est shows ever recorded.

ai_rating.rationale: All 30+ reviews give 5‑star praise, consistently lauding both performance and audio quality; the weight of evidence supports a near‑perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clean multitrack source praised as crystal clear; occasional nostalgic comment about original tape hiss but the released version is noted as superior with no dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Virtually no breaks between songs; a continuous, high‑energy ride from the opening Other One through the second set climax.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as ferocious on his SG with an unstoppable guitar solo; tone praised throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Called "on fire" and delivering his best show ever, even breaking into a classical‑style jam during New Potato Caboose.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brief mention of Brent's keyboard contribution on a rare version; otherwise no specific comments.
